en: Black‑and‑white divided postcard showing two rural scenes. On the left is a tree‑lined path leading to a farmhouse with views over a valley and distant hills; text below labels it as a view toward a meadow and riding area from a guesthouse named 'Landhaus am Waldessaum.' On the right, a young girl sits on a bench beside a tree, with another house and forested hills in the background, labeled as a house with Hochstein. Printed German text at the bottom gives the names and addresses of the properties in Ober‑Schreiberhau in the Riesengebirge mountains.
